newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to import 150,000 T red, white milling wheat. [CORRECTED 18:09 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Turkey to import 150,000 T red, white milling wheat. [CORRECTED 18:09 GMT]

text.p: Turkey would import 100,000 tonnes of red milling wheat and 50,000 tonnes of white milling wheat as a result of a tender finalised on Friday, an official said.

He said 50,000 tonnes of red wheat would be bought from Eksim foreign trade firm representing Farm Trading (corrects company name from "Sun Trading") and another 50,000 tonnes of red wheat would be bought from Romak and 50,000 tonnes of white milling wheat would be bought from Glencore.
He did not give any further details.
The official said prices and origin of wheat would be announced later.
The state grain board TMO had opened the tender on Tuesday with an option until Thursday evening to buy 200,000 tonnes of red and white milling wheat.
The tender was on a three-year credit basis and wheat from the U.S., Canada, Argentine, Australia and the European Union were considered. Bids were received from 12 traders.
